title: Range Sum Query 2D - Immutable
description:
Given a 2D integer matrix `matrix`, handle multiple queries of the following type:

- Calculate the **sum** of the elements of `matrix` inside the rectangle defined by its **upper-left corner** `(row1, col1)` and **lower-right corner** `(row2, col2)` (both inclusive).

Implement the `NumMatrix` class:
- `NumMatrix(int[][] matrix)` initializes the object with the integer matrix `matrix`.
- `int sumRegion(int row1, int col1, int row2, int col2)` returns the sum of the elements of `matrix` inside the rectangle `(row1, col1)` to `(row2, col2)` inclusive.

You must design an algorithm where `sumRegion` works in `O(1)` time complexity.
constraints: At most 10^4 calls will be made to sumRegion.
hints: Generalize 1D prefix sums to 2D by storing `prefix[r + 1][c + 1]` as the sum of the submatrix from `(0, 0)` to `(r, c)`.
Using inclusion-exclusion, `prefix[r + 1][c + 1] = matrix[r][c] + prefix[r][c + 1] + prefix[r + 1][c] - prefix[r][c]`.
For any query `(row1, col1, row2, col2)`, return `prefix[row2 + 1][col2 + 1] - prefix[row1][col2 + 1] - prefix[row2 + 1][col1] + prefix[row1][col1]`.

examples.explanation: Single-cell, single-row, single-column, and full-matrix regions are all handled in O(1) time.
